name: Gdańsk Cubing Summer Camp 2019
information: First part of each day will be focused on pro lessons with cubing teachers. After that we will have integration game and dinner. After the dinner we planned official competition with 2 or 3 rounds of the event. 1 or 2 events per day. We invite people who want to make progress with Fridrich Method 3x3x3 This competition will be a training and integration camp before polish youth championship.
